desc: Find all classes named Memory or containing Memory in the project
Find all classes named Brain in the project
Read the Memory class file to see all its methods
Read the Brain class starting from line 55 to see all its methods

args.code:
import re

with open('/workspaces/empty/coding-agent/limbs/memory/google_store.py') as f:
    memory_text = f.read()
with open('/workspaces/empty/coding-agent/brain/core.py') as f:
    brain_text = f.read()

memory_methods = re.findall(r'    def (\w+)', memory_text)
brain_methods = re.findall(r'    def (\w+)', brain_text)

print('=== Memory (GoogleMemory) methods ===')
for m in sorted(memory_methods):
    print(f'  {m}')
print()
print('=== Brain methods ===')
for m in sorted(brain_methods):
    print(f'  {m}')
print()

shared = set(memory_methods) & set(brain_methods)
print(f'Shared methods: {shared if shared else "NONE"}')
print()
if shared == set(memory_methods) and shared == set(brain_methods):
    print('RESULT: Memory class has the SAME methods as Brain')
else:
    print(f'RESULT: Memory class does NOT have the same methods as Brain')
    print(f'  Memory has {len(memory_methods)} methods, Brain has {len(brain_methods)} methods')
